description: Lap times / telemetry for an F1 session: per-lap duration, sector times, speed-trap, pit-out flag. Live race data. session_key="latest" for the most recent / ongoing session. Optionally filter by driver_number or lap_number.

driver_number.description: Restrict to a single driver, e.g. 1, 44.

session_key.description: Session key, or 'latest' for the most recent session. Required.

name: get_laps
